newsitem.title: USA: Capital One Q4 chargeoff rate up to 5.11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Capital One Q4 chargeoff rate up to 5.11 pct.

text.p: Capital One Financial Corp said on Wednesday that its managed net charge-off rate for the fourth quarter increased to 5.11 percent versus 4.19 percent in the third quarter.
The charge-off rate for all of 1996 was 4.24 percent compared with 2.25 percent for 1995.
The year-end managed delinquency rate increased to 6.42 percent versus 5.31 percent at September 30, 1996 and 4.20 percent at December 31, 1995, Capital One said.
It said these increases are due to continued softening of consumer credit, an ongoing shift in the product mix to higher-yielding products for underserved segments and slower portfolio growth.
Capital One reported fourth quarter net income of $0.60 per share compared with $0.57 per share in the prior year quarter.
